dialogue.text: Hi there! Thank you for calling MultiTracks Playback support. I'm Penny, your virtual AI support assistant. How can I have the pleasure of helping you today?
I'm getting ready for rehearsal on our iPad, but Graves into Gardens won't open. I press try again once and it still stuck
Thanks for sharing that. Let me check
That song is in your plan. Can you tap Try Again once more and tell me exactly what message you see if it still stays stuck?
Okay, good to know. Let me take a look.
Can you tap Try Again one more time? The third attempt runs a different recovery routine. Did Graves Into Gardens open after that?
Uh, the next try still didn't work but I pressed it again and it opened now. Thank you
Glad it's opening now. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thanks so much for calling MultiTracks Playback support. Have a great day, and goodbye! Just checking in, are you still there?
